destination.name: Geelong
destination.tagline: A port city on Corio Bay and the gateway to the Bellarine and Great Ocean Road
destination.description: Geelong is Victoria's second-largest city, home to 282,809 people in 2023, on Corio Bay about 75 km south-west of Melbourne. Its waterfront is a working maritime area with cafes, an antique carousel and botanical gardens. The National Wool Museum on Moorabool Street takes about 90 minutes and holds a tourist information office. You Yangs Regional Park, 22 km north, has a 3.2 km walk to Flinders Peak (348 m).
whyVisit: Walk up to wide hill views

goodToKnow.title: Avalon Airport is close
goodToKnow.detail: Avalon Airport, a second Melbourne-area airport, is about 20 minutes by road from Geelong, with a shuttle to Geelong and South Geelong stations.

goodToKnow.title: Cycle to Queenscliff
goodToKnow.detail: The 35 km Bellarine Rail Trail starts near South Geelong Station and runs to Queenscliff.
